agents.name: Claude.ai
steps: Click "Upload skill" and choose the ZIP.
Start a new chat. Claude loads the skill automatically when it's relevant.

agents.name: Claude Desktop
steps: Click "+" → "Upload a skill" and choose the ZIP.
Start a new conversation. The skill activates when relevant.

agents.name: ChatGPT
steps: Open the skill instructions below and copy them.
In ChatGPT, create a Project (or a custom GPT) and paste them into its instructions.
Upload any files from the skill's references folder as project files.
